biometric.not_enrolled_description: Set up Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint unlock on this device before pairing a host. Return here after enrollment to continue.
biometric.hardware_unavailable_descripti: This device does not report biometric hardware. Pairing a host requires a device with enrolled biometrics.
biometric.hardware_unavailable_setup_des: This device did not report biometric hardware to PocketShell. Open device settings to confirm Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint unlock is enabled, then return here.
biometric.setup_description: Host pairing requires Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint unlock on this device. Set it up in your device settings, then return to PocketShell.
biometric.setup_checking: Checking whether this device has biometric unlock enrolled.
biometric.setup_status_needed: Enrollment required before pairing can continue.
scan_qr.web_fallback: QR scanning isn't supported on web. Please use the pairing code flow instead.
scan_qr.camera_permission_description: PocketShell needs camera access to scan the pairing QR displayed by your host's CLI.
scan_qr.key_mismatch_description: Host pubkey mismatch — this host may have been reconnected. Proceed only if you trust this QR.
scan_qr.trusted_host_description: Add this device to {{host}} (trusted host). Continue?
scan_qr.adding_device_description: Adding device to host {{host}}. The host is not yet in your device list.
scan_qr.instructions: Run {{command}} on your host, then point your camera at the QR code.
